beats.text: Every Icelander has 445,023 cubic meters of internal freshwater. Kuwait has zero.
Renewable internal freshwater resources flows refer to internal river flows and groundwater from rainfall.
Iceland has 439 times the water India gets, with India at 1,014 m³.
The lowest nations include Saudi Arabia with 75 m³, Jordan with 61 m³, and Egypt with 9 m³.
